_note: How interest an assessee pays is calculated: the amount rounded down to a multiple of ₹100, a fraction of a month counted as a whole month where the section says 'part of a month'. Read in Rules 2026 r.269(b), (c); the TY 2025-26 counterpart, Rules 1962 r.119A, has no Gazette copy in the repo, so that version is UNVERIFIED and carries r.269's figures (D-446 C4a). Sources: sources/2026-11-06-advance-tax-interest.md; D-446.
